description: One SEC EDGAR filing record by accession number, read from the first-seen store. The store holds filings of filers this service has touched; it is not a global accession index, and an unknown accession returns 404 after the payment gate. $0.005 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: GET https://exchangerebel.com/toll/secfilings/filing/{accession}.
name: sec_filing_record
